field.name: reasonCounts
field.type: { unwritable: Record<string, number>; awaiting: Record<string, number> }
field.purpose: counts of unwritable relationships and of awaiting-target rows by reason, so completeness can say why a repository is incomplete (e.g. targets excluded by an ignore rule vs. not stored yet)

rationale: RepoCompleteness.reasons must name each cause with its count; the sketch's unwritable and pending['awaiting-target'] are single numbers, and an import of a file an ignore rule excludes (a real gap the user must see) must be told apart from a target that is not stored yet. The field is additive and owned by s1.
rejectedReason: Duplicate of AMD-c2ba6fa62a148ed1-2 (identical sharedContract.fieldAdd reasonCounts on sc1), re-filed by each re-run of design.story for s1 on 2026-10-14; stakeholder decision: approve AMD-2, reject the duplicates.
